summary: Sunoco LP filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash distribution of $0.9899 per common unit ($3.9596 annualized) for Q1 2026, a 6.25% increase from the prior quarter. The distribution is payable May 20, 2026 to holders of record as of May 8, 2026. This is a routine capital return event—not a special situation—with no acquisition, divestiture, or structural change. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or risk-arb elements. It is a standard quarterly distribution announcement and does not warrant classification as a special situation.
